## Description

A tiny marine centric diatom (4–6 µm) shaped like a round box; cultured at 14 °C, grows between 4 and
25 °C. The first diatom with a sequenced genome.

## In the simulation

<!-- GENERATED:presence -->
Drops: not seeded in the default drops (inoculate it from the Catalogue).
<!-- /GENERATED -->

A small disc diatom; marine, inoculated from the catalogue.
